item.title: New Radar Signal Processing Course
item.description: I am developing a new Radar Signal Processing course at Utah State University (USU) for Fall 2026 semester. The course will be ECE 5930/6930 and enrollment is already fill with a mix of graduate students and senior undergraduate students.
